notes: #2 is the 1645 French-edition copy of the 1572 plate, dated by first publication; #4 (UBHD) is the same strip in color but only 2029 px wide. #9: Commons says “by 1872”; it is from the 1872 second edition, whose new plates were after Schuch (born 1843), so 1872 is the year made. #11 is Amsterdam, miscategorized. #12 publisher per Commons category; the upper left of the card has ink blots, hence the narrow trim (68% of width).
